purpose: Extend and verify official/institutional secondary research for Sud-Vest Oltenia, Sud-Muntenia and Centru without converting project activity, training supply, administrative labour-market context or event-specific recruitment into AI4WORK need-prevalence claims.

promoted_sources.title: Cursuri de (re)calificare organizate de AJOFM Gorj in anul 2025
promoted_sources.claim_boundary: The official course offer maps institutional supply only. It does not measure demand, skill-gap prevalence or AI-specific need and contributes zero H1-H5 points.

promoted_sources.title: Programe de formare profesionala planificate de AJOFM Dambovita pentru anul 2025
promoted_sources.claim_boundary: A planned training catalogue is supply context, not a measurement of employer/adult demand, competence deficit or AI4WORK need prevalence. It contributes zero H1-H5 points.

promoted_sources.title: Raport asupra activitatii AJOFM Covasna, situatiei somajului, programelor de ocupare si formare profesionala, pentru anul 2025
promoted_sources.claim_boundary: These are administrative training and placement outcomes under a constrained budget/supply environment. They do not represent population prevalence of digital/AI skill gaps, do not support causal attribution and contribute zero H1-H5 points.

promoted_sources.title: Rezultate Bursa Generala a Locurilor de Munca
promoted_sources.claim_boundary: This is a single recruitment-event snapshot. It is not representative of the county or region and does not measure competence deficit, AI skill need or training-demand prevalence. It contributes zero H1-H5 points.

promoted_sources.title: Bursa Locurilor de Munca pentru Absolventi - comunicat 09.10.2025
promoted_sources.claim_boundary: This recruitment event is not a representative employer survey. The presence of IT, automation and CNC roles does not quantify digital/AI skill gaps or training-demand prevalence and contributes zero H1-H5 points.

promoted_sources.title: Raport de activitate AJOFM Harghita 2025
promoted_sources.claim_boundary: Administrative vacancies and training delivery are partial and supply-entangled. Digital-course participation is not converted into need prevalence and the vacancy mix cannot establish presence or absence of an AI skill gap. It contributes zero H1-H5 points.

Sud-Vest Oltenia.current_complement: S55 maps training supply and S58 adds a current event-specific recruitment snapshot that includes some digital roles, both strictly zero-weight context.

Sud-Muntenia.current_complement: S56 maps training supply and S59 adds a current event-specific recruitment snapshot containing IT/automation/CNC roles, both strictly zero-weight context.

Centru.current_complement: S57 maps Covasna supply constraints and S60 adds Harghita administrative vacancies/training context, both without treating provision or vacancies as need prevalence.
